description: How the predicted funding of one coin moved over time, per venue, in 15-minute slots (the first reading of each slot): the first and newest predicted APR, the range and the newest slots. Use it for "has the predicted BTC funding been rising today?".

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, at most 250 = 1,000 slots). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

venue.description: Only this venue (default every venue the licence allows).

name: get_predicted_funding_history

byVenue.description: Per venue: slots, first and last (t, apr), high, low, intervalHours.

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

points.description: Newest slots: t, byVenue (fundingHourly, fundingApr, intervalHours, nextFundingTime).

slots.description: Slots of 15 minutes in the answer.

title: Predicted funding history
